main_text.p: quia vident illa stante nova sua dogmata ruere oportere. ℞. Imo vero, quia vident ab ea, non absque insigni contumelia in Deum, & summo cum dispendio populi christiani, Domini nostri Jesu Christi & verbi divini auctoritatem ac veritatem indignissime conculcari. 13. Protestantes quidem videri velle singulares zelotas, & sectatores apostolorum; at revera probare, quam parum faciant mandata Domini; nullibi enim in S. literis permittit ejusmodi discedendi licentiam, sed potius juberi. 2 Thef. 3. 14. & alibi, ut non habeamus errantem velut inimicum, sed admoneamus ut fratrem. ℞. Quid exigant S. literae, liquet ex ante-dictis. In epist. ad Thef. jubetur praeterea, ut nullum commercium habeamus cum illo, qui non obedit sermoni evangelico. deinde apostolus intelligit illos, de quibus spes emendationis superest: at jurati pontificis Romani oppugnant aperte doctrinam Christi, & ab ea malitiose ac pertinaciter fideles abalienare student; tanquam ministri Satanae, & aperti hostes Christi & professionis evangelicae, de quibus apostolus ad Tit. cap. 3. vers. 10. page.notes: Marks ℞ before "Imo" and "Quid" and the section numbers 13 and 14 are read with some doubt; the ℞ mark is shown as printed but may be a different sign. Line-end hyphen in "cano-" kept as printed; the text continues on the next page. "Thef." is printed as such and kept.
